overview: This 544-page file traces Japan’s wartime finances through budgets, bond issues, gold and foreign exchange reserves, and access to American, British, and Swiss credit. Diplomatic, consular, military, and private correspondence examines the costs of the war in China, Japan’s vulnerability to economic pressure, and disputes over Japanese government and City of Tokyo bonds.
interest: Detailed budget enclosures and competing diplomatic assessments reveal how officials judged Japan’s financial resilience and prospects for economic pressure.
